I just finished Welcome to the NHK, and wanted to throw a recommendation /v/anime's way.

NHK follows Sato Tatsuhiro, a hikikomori (shut-in) and a NEET (Not Educated, Employed, or Training). The niece of a door-to-door evangelist, the noisy otaku neighbor, and the paranoid senpai of yore all come into play as Sato sets out on the winding road that is life. Will Sato recover from his social anxiety? Or is everything a conspiracy by the evil NHK (Nihon Hikikomori Kyokai/Japanese Social Withdrawal Organization) to keep Sato out of society?

I can't say that I enjoyed this show, simply because "enjoyed" is not the right word. Welcome to the NHK is the closest I have ever seen an anime replicate real life. Real life is fun, at times, but crushing, at others. Indeed, the characters of NHK feel very much alive in this way. But the fact that NHK resembles real life does not mean that it is boring, by any means. Rather, NHK has a unique ability to explore the hearts and minds of its characters in a way that most everyone can relate to. Sato and the others all feel very real happiness, as well as very real pain. There are times when you will wear a gleaming smile because you know the feeling of being in love, and there are times when you will cry bitter tears because you understand the hopelessness in life.

The series does not waste the special position it finds itself in. NHK delves into the struggles of those who have social anxiety, depression, paranoia, lack of self-esteem or self-worth, and questions about the choices they've made. Throughout the series, the cast is presented with various strugges that they either overcome or buckle in the face of: Things that we all do from time to time in our own lives. In these situations, the viewer can often find him or herself, and this is where NHK shines.

If you've ever wondered what the purpose or value of life is, NHK will not give you answers. Just like in real life, there are no decisive answers in NHK. Instead, the characters will ask such qusetions right alongside you.
